finalState.description: The terminal RunState, exactly as `task_workspace_settle` takes it: the Rust arm deserializes this into `cognia_task_workspace::RunState`, which is a camelCase string. It was declared as an object here, so every settle of a bundle turn was refused 422 and the run stayed `running` after a turn that had completed, wedging the session's next turn.
